title: Can Quantum Field Theory be Recovered from Time-Symmetric Stochastic Mechanics? Part II: Prospects for a Trajectory Interpretation
summary: In a companion paper we derived a unique time-reversal-invariant stochastic generalization of the Liouville equation and showed that it coincides with the evolution equation for the Husimi $Q$-function in a broad class of bosonic quantum field theories. Here we investigate the prospects for interpreting that evolution equation in terms of underlying stochastic trajectories.
